evals.name: present-a0201-strong-binders
evals.prompt: I have a list of candidate peptides at /Users/ukevi/.claude/plugins/comp-immunology/skills/netmhcpan-workspace/eval_inputs/candidates.pep. Which of them are predicted to be strongly presented by HLA-A*02:01? Give me the strong binders with their %Rank.
evals.expected_output: Runs the 4.2c command netMHCpan with -a HLA-A02:01, identifies strong binders as %Rank_EL <= 0.5 (or BindLevel SB), and lists at least NLVPMVATV and LLFGYPVYV among the strong binders with their ranks.

assertions.text: Passed the allele as -a HLA-A02:01 (correct colon naming, no asterisk on input)
Defined strong binders by %Rank_EL <= 0.5 or BindLevel SB (not by raw EL score)
Correctly lists NLVPMVATV and LLFGYPVYV as strong binders with rank values
Did NOT report a fabricated or hallucinated rank — values match a real run

evals.name: multiallele-ba-tidy-table
evals.prompt: Run NetMHCpan on the peptides in /Users/ukevi/.claude/plugins/comp-immunology/skills/netmhcpan-workspace/eval_inputs/candidates.pep across HLA-A01:01, HLA-A02:01 and HLA-B07:02, including binding affinity. I want a tidy CSV with one row per peptide-allele pair (columns for EL rank and BA rank) that I can load straight into pandas.
evals.expected_output: Runs netMHCpan with -BA and all three alleles and -xls, then produces a tidy/long CSV with one row per (peptide, allele) = 30 rows, with EL rank and BA rank columns correctly parsed (not a wide table, not mis-skipped rows).

assertions.text: Ran netMHCpan with -BA and all three alleles
Produced -xls structured output (rather than scraping stdout)
Final CSV is long/tidy: one row per peptide-allele pair (30 data rows for 10 peptides x 3 alleles)
CSV has distinct EL-rank and BA-rank columns with correct numeric values
Did not corrupt the table by using the wrong .xls skiprows or mis-melting the wide multi-allele blocks

evals.name: version-compare-4.1-vs-4.2
evals.prompt: Reproduce the HLA-A*02:01 presentation predictions for the peptides in /Users/ukevi/.claude/plugins/comp-immunology/skills/netmhcpan-workspace/eval_inputs/candidates.pep using the older NetMHCpan 4.1, and compare them to the current version. Do any of the strong/weak binder calls change between versions?
evals.expected_output: Runs BOTH netMHCpan-4.1 and netMHCpan (4.2c) on the same peptides/allele, compares %Rank_EL or SB/WB calls per peptide, reports which calls change, and notes that the two versions are not interchangeable (EL net retrained).

assertions.text: Ran BOTH versions: netMHCpan-4.1 AND netMHCpan (4.2c)
Compared the same peptides across versions (per-peptide EL rank or SB/WB call)
Identified at least one peptide whose binder call or rank differs between versions
Noted the versions are not interchangeable / should not be mixed (EL network retrained)
